title: release-codex-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified Codex plugin release from the committed marketplace source.

requirements.summary: Release only the Codex adapter artifact family without npm publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the Codex adapter fourth segment and matching manifest are bumped.
The committed marketplace payload and metadata are complete and verified.
The exact vcodex-<version> tag and GitHub Release point to clean origin/main.
No npm package or plugin ZIP is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Codex release baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, manifests, marketplace metadata, and every worktree change. Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Prepare the Codex adapter version and payload
tasks.detail: Bump only the Codex adapter fourth segment, align its plugin manifest and canonical driver pin, validate source inputs, and assemble the unchanged flat runtime with complete skills into isolated output. Review the source and artifact diffs separately.

tasks.title: Verify built-in templated skill compatibility
tasks.detail: Run `npm run check:template-versions` before candidate tests. It scans every built-in skill package that contains TEMPLATE.json and verifies that its version matches TEMPLATE_DRIVER_VERSION; stop and repair version drift before publishing.

tasks.title: Verify the Codex plugin candidate
tasks.detail: Run focused adapter and marketplace bundle tests, template/shared-skill checks, git diff --check, and npm run verify:release prerequisites justified by the diff.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: Commit intended source on main, push origin/main, require clean source equality and run the relevant release gate. Export a complete Git marketplace artifact and obtain the explicitly authorized publication target/ref before publishing it. Never publish the raw incomplete adapter directory or restore source copies. Tag the artifact release immutably as vcodex-<version>; record its source revision and artifact identity. No npm or ZIP publication.

tasks.title: Verify the immutable Codex release
tasks.detail: Verify tag, release, committed marketplace paths and manifests, and repository cleanliness. If a maintainer installation refresh is separately authorized, first remove every local claw-kit marketplace registration, plugin identity, hook configuration, and cache tree; then refresh only from the published GitHub source, enable claw-kit@claw-kit, and verify its source/cache manifests. Never leave or enable a local claw-kit identity as the normal runtime.

references.why: Owns the Codex plugin release contract.

rules: Never publish npm packages or attach a plugin ZIP.
Never modify another artifact family without explicit batch authority.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
